provisions.summary: Raises the standard deduction to $10,000 (joint/surviving spouse), $7,500 (head of household) and $5,000 (single/married filing separately) from tax year 2024, then indexes it every year after 2024 by a cost-of-living adjustment factor. The factor is the July-to-July change in the Urban Hawaii CPI, which the bill does not state, so the 2027-2031 amounts cannot be modeled.
provisions.quote: For each taxable year beginning after December 31, 2024, the director, no later than December 15 of the preceding calendar year, shall recompute the standard deduction amounts

provisions.summary: Replaces the brackets for tax years after 2023 with wider ones for joint, head-of-household and single filers, keeping the 1.4%-11% rates. From tax year 2025 the bracket thresholds are indexed annually by the same unstated cost-of-living adjustment factor, so the 2027-2031 brackets cannot be modeled.
provisions.quote: shall recompute the taxable income amounts within each of the income brackets in subsections (a), (b), and (c)

notes: Both modeled provisions depend on annual indexing to a CPI-based factor the bill does not state, so no figures for 2027-2031 can be put in the spec (rules 5 and 6). The only fixed schedules in the bill are the tax year 2024 brackets (e.g., joint 1.4% up to $5,126 through 11% over $427,200) and the 2024 standard deduction amounts. Both are indexed from tax year 2025 onward. Section 1 (the definition of the cost-of-living adjustment factor) is definition-only and is not listed as a provision. It sets the factor as 1.0 plus the July-to-July percentage change in the Urban Hawaii CPI for all items, falling back to the Chained CPI-U if the Hawaii CPI is discontinued. If the factor is zero or negative in a year, no adjustment is made the following year. Tax rates are unchanged, and the estate/trust table, the section 235-51(f) capital gains alternative tax (7.25%) and Act 163 credits are not touched. The bill has no sunset. Section 5 sets the effective date at July 1, 3000, which looks like a placeholder, and applicability to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2023. This is a 2024-session draft that predates Act 24, SLH 2026, so its 2024 brackets and deduction amounts would conflict with current law's schedules. No first_year is given because no provision is modeled for 2027-2031.
